title: SERV (olofk/serv)
_note: The bit-serial RISC-V core (rtl/), the servant reference SoC with its many
board tops (servant/), the servile convenience wrapper and the serving
SoC.  FuseSoC is only the packaging; the Verilog needs no generation.
define (IBUFDS, CC_USR_RSTN, CLKINT / GND / VCC, SB_HFOSC); every other
Board tops (servant_<board>, their *_clock_gen wrappers and the PLL wrappers)
instantiate vendor PLL / IO primitives (EHXPLLL, PLL_BASE, MMCME2_BASE, SB_HFOSC,
IBUFDS, CLKINT ...) that no file of the repository defines, so they have no
read_slang reference; they are excluded and the family is the core, the servant
SoC and its peripherals.  `servant` itself reads and co-simulates but has no
read_slang reference because its memfile parameter names zephyr_hello.hex
